description: Hand-authored appsec-review/codeql-graph-export/1 objects over source/app.js, source/cli.js and source/store.ts, written to be consistent with rules/codeql-graph-export/javascript. They are a deliberately chosen subset of what the pack would export: synthetic default-constructor calls (new FileStore(), new MemoryStore()), flow summaries from route-handler parameters through property reads, and intermediate declaration nodes of the path graph are omitted; display strings are source text rather than CodeQL's abbreviated toString(). They are not a CodeQL recording. bqrs_sha256 values are SHA-256 of the text 'hand-authored synthetic bqrs <query_id>'. The manifest pack hashes are computed over the pack directory and columns.json at authoring time and are not checked by load_graph_exports.

cases.remote_to_sql: Express req.query.id flows through buildQuery (a cross-function flow) into pg pool.query (SqlInjection::Sink -> sql_query).
cases.remote_to_path_sanitized: req.query.file passes path.basename (a catalog sanitizer, listed on the path and dominating the sink) before fs.readFileSync (TaintedPath::Sink -> path_access).
cases.remote_to_deserialization: req.body reaches node-serialize unserialize, a catalog API sink that suppresses the UnsafeDeserialization model on the same call.
cases.remote_to_html: req.query.name reaches res.send (ReflectedXss::Sink -> html_output) through an untracked receiver, so the call itself is unresolved_indirect.
cases.argv_source: process.argv is a commandargs threat-model source and flows into runCommand's execSync.
cases.env_source: process.env is an environment threat-model source and flows into runCommand's execSync.
cases.api_source_and_log_sink: readline-sync question is a catalog API source (no javascript-all model) feeding console.log (catalog API log_output sink) and execSync.
cases.guarded_sink: cp.exec(host) inside `if (host === "localhost")` has a dominating true_branch guard that constrains the operand.
cases.unguarded_sink: cp.exec("nslookup " + host) after the if has only a non_dominating condition and an explicit none row.
cases.flow_summary: buildQuery summarises parameter 0 -> return (taint); runCommand parameter 0 -> execSync sink (data); handleFile reads module-scope ROOT into the readFileSync sink (taint).
cases.virtual_dispatch: s.save(key) on a Store that is a MemoryStore or FileStore resolves to two candidates (virtual_resolved, candidate_count 2).
cases.unresolved_indirect_call: obj[name]() is a computed-member call with no resolvable target (unresolved_indirect).
cases.external_call: Calls into imported modules or global objects without source-root targets are external_undefined with their modules in callee_declared_in.
cases.crypto_random: Math.random() is a catalog API sink on the call itself (argument -1, crypto_misuse).
cases.range_not_applicable: JavaScript has no integral range semantics: every sink gets a not_applicable range row and range_conversions is empty.
